text:
Location: Ton Son Nhut in front of our hooch
The other Unit is somewhere in the background, the guy that did the shooting in the bathroom. They had just arrived maybe a week or so. The photo would probably be July of 1965. I got the camera about 3-weeks into Vietnam which would have been Oct of 1964.
researchNotes: Bears on the date of the bathroom shooting (ledger #11): the shooter's unit had 'just arrived maybe a week or so', and he dates this frame to about July 1965, against the timeline's February–March 1965. His son clarified the same day that 'just arrived' dates the other unit's arrival to about a week before this photograph, not the shooting; if the shooter was with that unit when he fired, that sits against the February–March dating. Not reconciled. Also the camera: 'about 3-weeks into Vietnam ... Oct of 1964'.
